title: Finite principal representatives of a twist section
statement: Let A be an N-graded commutative ring with grading 𝒜, k an integer, f homogeneous of positive degree b, and s a section of twist 𝒜 k on D₊(f). Put B=A_(f) and M=A_f. There exist a finite family g_i in B spanning the unit ideal and elements t_i in M localized at g_i. Whenever the image of g_i is a unit in A_p, the localization universal property gives an additive evaluation e_i to A_p which sends z/1 to the canonical image of z, is linear for B acting through A_f, and sends t_i to s(p).

source.place: Lemma 27.8.4 and its preceding construction, specialized to the shift A(k); this split separates ordinary gluing from degree detection

proof.text: Obtain a finite spanning family and representatives from twist_finiteLocal_values. For each point at which the chart element maps to a unit, construct the additive, scalar-compatible map with twist_finiteLocal_canonical_eval; apply the value property to this map.

proof_origin.place: Section 27.8 local representatives and ordinary module localization; G3 second reading combines finite values with the proved Mathlib localization lift.

lean.statement:
theorem twist_finiteLocal_representatives
    {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (k : ℤ) (f : A) (b : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 b)
    (s : (twist 𝒜 k).val.obj (op (basicOpen 𝒜 f))) :
    let B := HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f
    let M := LocalizedModule.Away f A
    letI : Module B M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f))
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → B) (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
      (t : ∀ i : Fin n, LocalizedModule.Away (g i) M),
      (∀ (i : Fin n) (p : basicOpen 𝒜 f),
      let F := IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
        (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
        (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2)
      IsUnit (F (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) (g i))) →
      ∃ e : LocalizedModule.Away (g i) M →+
          Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal,
        (∀ z : M, e (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (g i)) M z) = F z) ∧
        (∀ (a : B) (x : LocalizedModule.Away (g i) M),
          e (a • x) = F (algebraMap B (Localization.Away f) a) * e x) ∧
        e (t i) = (s.1 p).1)
